meta.title: 校风「和而不同，乐在其中」：找到热爱的事
meta.title_en: Harmony in Diversity, Joy in Pursuit

scenes.context: 讲者开讲校风第一句「和而不同」，解释它是人与世界打交道的方式。
sentences: 我们的校风叫「和而不同，乐在其中」。
Our school motto is "harmony in diversity, joy in pursuit."
校风：school motto
和而不同，实际上是我与世界怎么打交道。
Harmony in diversity is how I engage with the world.
与世界打交道：engage with the world
这个世界不仅是我一个人，有太多的万事万物。
The world is not just about me — it's filled with everything and everyone.
万事万物：everything and everyone
paraphrase: Harmony in diversity is a worldview.
Respecting difference is the wisdom of coexistence.
scenes.speak: Our school motto is "harmony in diversity, joy in pursuit." Harmony in diversity is how I engage with the world. The world is not just about me — it's filled with everything and everyone.

scenes.context: 讲者把第二句「乐在其中」解读为人生观：找到热爱的事并不断追求。
sentences: 一个人一定要找到自己最感兴趣的事情，然后去不断追求它。
You must find what fascinates you most, then keep pursuing it.
最感兴趣的事情：what fascinates you most
追求的快乐，才是最大的快乐。
The joy of pursuing is the greatest joy of all.
最大的快乐：the greatest joy
不为外界的东西，更多是我内在的这种兴趣。
It's not about external things — it's driven by my inner passion.
内在的兴趣：inner passion
paraphrase: Joy in pursuit is an outlook on life.
Joy lives in the pursuit, not the payoff.
scenes.speak: You must find what fascinates you most, then keep pursuing it. The joy of pursuing is the greatest joy of all. It's not about external things — it's driven by my inner passion.

scenes.title_en: Become the best version of yourself
scenes.context: 讲者把两句合起来：和而不同也要成就最好的自己，同时乐在其中。
sentences: 哪怕是粗茶淡饭，我也乐在其中。
Even with plain food and simple living, I'm still joyful in it.
粗茶淡饭：plain and simple living
我尽管和大家和而不同，但是我要成就最好的自己。
Even if I differ from everyone, I still aim to become the best version of myself.
成就最好的自己：become your best self
我又是乐在其中的。
And through it all, I stay joyful in the pursuit.
乐在其中：joyful in the pursuit
paraphrase: Keep your passion alive amid differences.
做好自己，同时与世界和谐
Be your best self while staying in harmony with the world.
scenes.speak: Even with plain food and simple living, I'm still joyful in it. Even if I differ from everyone, I still aim to become the best version of myself. And through it all, I stay joyful in the pursuit.

practice: I respect our differences and stay true to myself.
Find what fascinates you and keep pursuing it.
The joy of pursuing is the greatest joy.
Become the best version of yourself.
pitfalls: 「和而不同」有现成英文习语 harmony in diversity。
✓ 地道说法：The joy of pursuing it.
乐在其中强调「追求过程」，用 joy of pursuing。
✕ 直译腔：The world is not only me.
✓ 地道说法：The world is not just about me.
不只我一个人→not just about me。
✕ 直译腔：Plain tea and plain rice, I'm also happy.
✓ 地道说法：Even with plain food and simple living, I stay joyful.
粗茶淡饭→plain food and simple living。
shifts: 和而不同，成就最好的自己
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「何而不同」校正为「和而不同」、「承让」按语境校正为「成就」（成就最好的自己）、「无与说粗茶淡饭」校正为「哪怕是粗茶淡饭」；校风八字为专有表述保留原文。
